mergedParams.userDescription: Text appearing in 3D space, drifting slowly past the camera. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: 3D Text Drifting Through Space - Typokinetic Titles

prompts.prompt: Create a typokinetics preset that simulates text floating through a 3D space using CSS perspective and transform3d, like titles drifting through a sci-fi holographic interface. Think of this as camera dollying through text layers in a video editing timeline - each word or phrase exists at different Z-depths, creating natural parallax as they drift past. The text should feel weightless and ethereal, with subtle rotation on multiple axes as if suspended in zero gravity. Use staggered animations where closer text moves faster (parallax effect) and distant text moves slower and appears more blurred. Apply a subtle glow effect that pulses based on the text's proximity to the 'camera'. Consider using caption data to animate individual words with different drift speeds based on their impact scores - high-impact words move more prominently through the space.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Use nested BaseLayout containers with 'perspective-[1000px] preserve-3d' on the parent and multiple child containers at different z-depths using 'translate-z-[value]'. Each TextAtom should be wrapped in its own BaseLayout with 'absolute' positioning. Apply transform3d animations through the effects array with translateX, translateY, translateZ, rotateX, rotateY properties animating over the full duration. Use blur effect (0-3px) based on z-distance for depth of field. Add a glow effect using textShadow in the effects array, pulsing between '0 0 10px rgba(100,200,255,0.5)' and '0 0 20px rgba(100,200,255,0.8)'. Stagger start times using relative timing - closer elements start at 0, mid-range at 0.1, far elements at 0.2. Use 'ease-out' easing for natural deceleration. Performance: Add 'will-change-transform' to animated containers. If using caption data, iterate through words array and assign z-depths based on impact scores (0-1 mapped to translateZ 0-500px).

prompts.prompt: Design a typokinetics preset that creates a cinematic text reveal where words emerge from fog and drift past like film credits in a misty atmosphere. Imagine this as a layered composition in After Effects - background fog layer, multiple text layers with varying opacity and blur, and foreground fog overlay. The text should materialize from low opacity and high blur, becoming sharp and clear as it passes through the viewing plane, then fading back into the mist. Create depth using scale transformations combined with opacity - text starts small and transparent, scales up to 100% at the focal point, then continues scaling to 120% while fading out. Add subtle horizontal drift with slight random variation to simulate air currents affecting the text movement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use a three-layer BaseLayout structure: background fog (semi-transparent gradient div), text container, and foreground fog overlay. Main container uses 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Text container uses 'absolute inset-0 flex flex-col justify-center items-center'. For each text element, create a BaseLayout wrapper with initial 'scale-75 opacity-0' and animate via effects array: opacity (0 to 1 to 0), scale (0.75 to 1 to 1.2), blur (8px to 0 to 4px), translateX (-20px to 20px for drift). Use 'ease-in-out' easing over 4-6 second duration per text element. Fog layers use 'absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none' with linear gradients. If using caption data, map word timing to staggered animations - each word starts animation at its relative timestamp. Add subtle brightness filter animation (0.7 to 1 to 0.7) for fog-like dimming effect.

prompts.prompt: Build a typokinetics preset inspired by Star Wars opening crawl but in 3D space - text recedes into the distance along a perspective plane while also having lateral drift movement. Picture this as a 3D text layer in a video editor with both Z-axis movement (moving away) and X/Y drift (floating in space). The text should start large and close, then recede into a vanishing point while simultaneously drifting horizontally as if affected by cosmic winds. Add a starfield particle effect in the background with slowly moving stars at different depths. The text should have a slight metallic sheen that catches light as it moves, created through gradient text fills and animated highlights.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Parent BaseLayout with 'perspective-[800px] bg-black overflow-hidden'. Create a text container with 'preserve-3d' that rotates on X-axis using 'rotate-x-[60deg]' for the crawl angle. Each text line in its own BaseLayout with transform animations: translateZ (0 to -2000px), translateY (100vh to -100vh), translateX (sine wave -50px to 50px). Apply gradient text using 'bg-gradient-to-b from-yellow-200 via-yellow-400 to-yellow-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent'. Add animated textShadow for glow: '0 0 20px rgba(255,255,100,0.6)'. Starfield background uses multiple absolutely positioned divs with small white circles, each animating at different speeds using translateY. Duration should be long (10-15 seconds) with 'linear' easing for consistent movement. If using caption data, group words into sentences and animate each sentence as a line in the crawl.

prompts.prompt: Create a typokinetics preset that simulates text floating underwater with realistic drift and wave distortion. Think of this as underwater footage in a video editor - text moves with ocean currents, has caustic light patterns dancing across it, and exhibits the warping effect of looking through water. Text should drift in serpentine paths (using sine wave motion), with varying speeds suggesting different depths and current strengths. Apply a ripple distortion effect using CSS filters and transforms that makes the text appear to undulate. Add animated color shifts from deep blue to turquoise to simulate changing water depth and light penetration.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Main container with 'relative bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-900 via-blue-700 to-blue-500'. Each TextAtom wrapped in BaseLayout with complex animation path using effects array: translateX and translateY following sine curves (use Math.sin calculations in presetExecution), rotate with subtle oscillation (-5deg to 5deg). Apply SVG filter for water distortion using filter property in effects. Animate color from 'rgb(0,50,100)' to 'rgb(0,150,200)' over time. Add multiple blur/focus cycles (0 to 2px) to simulate depth changes. Use custom timing functions - some text moves with 'ease-in-out', others with 'linear' for variety. Create caustic light overlay using absolutely positioned semi-transparent divs with animated opacity and transform. Duration: 8-10 seconds per text element. If using caption data, use sentiment scores to determine drift intensity - positive sentiment drifts upward, negative downward.

prompts.prompt: Develop a typokinetics preset where text appears to be projected onto invisible 3D cubes rotating in space, creating a dynamic information display effect. Imagine editing a motion graphics piece where text is mapped onto rotating 3D objects - as the cubes turn, different faces reveal different text elements. Each word or phrase should be positioned on a cube face, and as the cube rotates, the text naturally appears and disappears with proper 3D perspective. Add subtle particle effects that trail behind the rotating text, like digital dust or data fragments. Include depth-based focusing where cubes closer to the viewer are sharp while distant ones are slightly blurred.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create cube structures using BaseLayout with 'preserve-3d transform-style-preserve-3d'. Each cube has 6 face containers positioned with translateZ and appropriate rotations (rotateY for sides, rotateX for top/bottom). Place TextAtom components on cube faces. Animate cube rotation using rotateX and rotateY in effects array with continuous rotation over duration. Parent container needs 'perspective-[1200px]'. Position multiple cubes at different 3D coordinates using translateX, translateY, translateZ. Apply blur effect based on z-position (0-4px range). Particle trail effect using absolutely positioned small divs that spawn at text position and animate with opacity fade and translateY drift. Use 'linear' easing for smooth rotation. Add subtle scale animation (0.9 to 1.1) synchronized with rotation for breathing effect. If using caption data, distribute words across available cube faces based on timing.

prompts.prompt: Design a typokinetics preset that creates a Matrix-style digital rain effect but with meaningful text instead of random characters. Picture this as a complex compositing setup in video editing software - multiple text columns falling at different speeds, with text materializing at the top and dissolving at the bottom. The text should drift horizontally while falling, creating organic curved paths rather than straight drops. Implement a 'focus wave' effect where text temporarily becomes brighter and clearer as an invisible scan line passes through. Add subtle glitch effects where text occasionally flickers or shifts position briefly, suggesting data transmission through an unstable connection.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use CSS Grid for column layout with 'grid grid-cols-12 gap-2 h-full'. Each column is a BaseLayout container with 'relative overflow-hidden'. TextAtom elements positioned absolutely within columns, animating translateY from -100% to 120% of container height. Add translateX with sine wave motion (±20px) for drift. Implement cascading opacity: start at 0, peak at 1 around 20% height, fade to 0.3 at bottom. Color animation from 'rgb(0,255,0)' to 'rgb(0,150,0)' as text falls. Focus wave using a moving brightness filter (1 to 1.5 to 1) with staggered timing across columns. Glitch effect: occasional rapid translateX shifts (±5px) and textShadow changes. Use varying animation durations (3-8 seconds) per column for organic movement. Random start delays (0-2 seconds) for each text element. If using caption data, parse words and distribute across columns based on impact scores.

prompts.prompt: Create a typokinetics preset mimicking text being viewed through a rotating cylindrical display, like words wrapping around a virtual column that slowly spins. Think of this as a 3D text wrap effect in video editing - text follows the curvature of an invisible cylinder, appearing from behind and disappearing as it rotates. The perspective should make text at the sides appear compressed while text at the front appears normal width. Add a subtle light source effect where text facing the 'camera' is brighter and text rotating away dims. Include atmospheric depth with fog that obscures text as it moves to the back of the cylinder.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Parent BaseLayout with 'perspective-[1000px] flex justify-center items-center'. Create cylinder using rotateY animation on a container with 'preserve-3d'. Position text elements using translateZ to push them to cylinder surface (e.g., translateZ(200px)) and rotateY for angular positioning around cylinder. Each TextAtom gets positioned at different angles (0deg, 30deg, 60deg, etc.). Animate parent container rotateY from 0 to 360deg continuously. Apply scaleX transformation based on rotation angle using effects array - scale from 1 at front to 0.7 at sides. Brightness filter animates from 1 at front (rotateY 0deg) to 0.5 at back (rotateY 180deg). Add fog overlay div with 'absolute inset-0' and radial gradient opacity. Use 'linear' easing for smooth rotation. Duration: 10-15 seconds for full rotation. If using caption data, space words evenly around cylinder circumference based on their timestamps.

prompts.prompt: Build a typokinetics preset where text appears to be floating in a wind tunnel, with aerodynamic drift and turbulence effects. Imagine this as a particle simulation in a video editor - text elements are affected by invisible force fields, creating swirling motions, sudden direction changes, and speed variations. Text should enter from one side, get caught in circular wind patterns, spiral around, then exit. Add motion blur during rapid movements and implement size changes suggesting movement toward/away from viewer. Include subtle rotation on all axes as text tumbles through the air currents.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Container with 'relative overflow-hidden'. Each TextAtom in BaseLayout with complex path animation using bezier curves in effects array. Implement turbulence using combined transforms: translateX/Y following spiral paths (calculate using parametric equations in presetExecution), translateZ for depth (-200px to 200px), scale (0.8 to 1.3) for distance effect. Rotation on all axes: rotateX (0 to 720deg), rotateY (0 to 540deg), rotateZ (0 to 360deg) with different speeds. Motion blur using filter blur (0 to 3px) based on velocity - calculate speed between keyframes and apply proportional blur. Add opacity variations (0.7 to 1) simulating density changes in air current. Use 'cubic-bezier' easing with custom curves for natural acceleration/deceleration. Stagger entry times for continuous flow effect. Duration: 5-7 seconds per element. If using caption data, use impact scores to determine turbulence intensity.

prompts.prompt: Design a typokinetics preset that simulates text being viewed through a kaleidoscope, with symmetrical patterns and prismatic drift effects. Picture this as a multi-layer mirrored composition in video editing - text is duplicated and reflected across multiple axes, creating beautiful symmetrical patterns that shift and morph. Each text element should drift from the center outward while rotating, with copies mirrored at 60-degree intervals (hexagonal symmetry). Add color shifting effects that cycle through spectrum colors as text moves. Include a subtle twist distortion that makes the entire pattern appear to spiral.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create hexagonal symmetry using 6 BaseLayout containers, each rotated by 60deg increments (0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300). Parent container with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center'. Each symmetry segment uses 'absolute' positioning with transform-origin at center. Clone TextAtom elements into each segment. Animate from center outward using radial movement: translateX and translateY calculated from polar coordinates (radius increases from 0 to 300px, angle rotates 0 to 360deg). Apply hue-rotate filter animation (0deg to 360deg) for color shifting. Add scale animation (0.5 to 1.2) synchronized with radial distance. Implement twist using gradual rotation increase on parent container. Use 'ease-in-out' for smooth motion. Opacity fade from 1 to 0 as elements reach edges. Duration: 6-8 seconds. If using caption data, use different words for each kaleidoscope generation cycle.

prompts.prompt: Create a typokinetics preset where text appears to be carved into layers of glass sliding past each other at different depths, like a parallax view through multiple transparent planes. Think of this as a multiplane camera setup in traditional animation - each glass layer moves at different speeds creating depth parallax, with text etched into the glass having subtle refraction effects. Text should drift horizontally at speeds inversely proportional to their depth, with closer layers moving faster. Add subtle light refraction effects where text appears to bend light passing through it. Include depth-of-field blur where only one layer is in sharp focus at a time, with focus shifting between layers.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Stack multiple BaseLayout layers with 'absolute inset-0' and different z-index values. Each layer represents a glass plane with 'backdrop-blur-[1px]' for glass effect. Position TextAtom elements on different layers using translateZ for true 3D depth (-500px to 500px range). Animate translateX at different speeds: foreground 100px/s, midground 50px/s, background 25px/s. Apply glassmorphism using 'bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm' on text containers. Implement refraction using skewX transform (-2deg to 2deg) animated subtly. Focus effect using blur filter animation - only one layer has blur: 0 at a time, others have blur: 2-6px based on distance from focus plane. Focus plane shifts using sequential animation timing. Add subtle brightness variations (0.9 to 1.1) suggesting light transmission. Use 'linear' easing for consistent drift. Duration: 10-12 seconds for full pass. If using caption data, distribute words across layers based on their importance/impact scores.
